name: 01-install-desktop
description: The same installer, pointed at this computer: pick a release and download the app.

steps.title: Install it on your computer
steps.caption: Install it on your computer. No device required.
The same installer that flashes a device also runs MoonLight on your computer, with no hardware at all.
Instead of picking a USB port, pick this computer.
It works out which build your machine needs by itself: this one is macOS.
One button, and the app downloads. That is the whole installation.
